change: A healthy compatible installation launches from IndexedDB before requesting an original image.

sourcePolicy.default: Reuse the last installation, including one imported from a local file.
sourcePolicy.explicitImage: Reuse only the same resolved URL; other sources use image import.
sourcePolicy.nocache: Skip cache reads and import the image again.
sourcePolicy.matchingImageBytes: Keep resources and remember the new source URL.
